text: 下面进入小作文 06 · 告示 Notice：校园歌唱比赛（对齐 2020 英一规范），英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 物称一句全包】中式写法：We will hold a singing contest for foreign students at 7 pm。请用 To do 目的状语 + is scheduled to host 写出：
To enrich campus life and help international students make more friends, the Student Union is scheduled to host a Singing Contest at the University Hall from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on May 20.
手术刀点拨：一句交代目的、主办方、活动名、地点、时间，干净利落。
【二段 · 规则细节】要求每人唱一首中文或英文歌，专业老师担任评委。请用 is expected to 与 with 独立主格挂载：
First, each participant is expected to sing one Chinese or English song, with professional teachers serving as judges.
手术刀点拨：用逗号 with + 名词 + doing 替代新起一句 They will be judges，零语法破绽且高级感强。
【收尾 · 倒装+落款】用 Not only can 点出“提供舞台又设奖项”，并注意本题落款为何写 The Student Union：
Second, not only can this contest offer a stage to display your talent, but it also provides prizes for the top three winners.
手术刀点拨：2020 真题要求 Do not use your own name 且未提 Li Ming，因此右下角署名主办方 The Student Union！
